summary:
Shantety E-commerce Final Architecture Safety Corrections & Acceptance Specification.
Comprehensive read-only technical blueprint covering:
1. Mandatory execution boundaries and strict evidence classification.
2. Server-authoritative payment lifecycle (Paymob HMAC verification, distinct payment states, separation from orders).
3. Inventory integrity and atomic checkout (quantity limits, duplicate variant aggregation, deterministic row locks, 30m reservation expiry, decoupled restocking).
4. Database-level idempotency (idempotency_keys table, SHA-256 payload fingerprinting, HTTP 409 conflict).
5. Secure cryptographic guest order claiming protocol (one-time token verification, zero PII exposure).
6. RPC and database function security hardening (SECURITY DEFINER, pg_catalog search_path, explicit schema qualification, least privilege).
7. Immutable owner protection via Supabase Auth UUID (marked UNVERIFIED pending authoritative inspection).
8. Cloudflare variable and secret matrix (strict browser vs secret isolation, production detection, strict CORS origins).
9. Complete commerce persistence and authorization audit across all 14 business entities.
10. Four distinct finite state machines (Order, Payment, Inventory, Refund/Return).
11. Migration safety, drift inspection, and staging recovery plan.
12. Final RPC/Function authorization matrix.
13. Release roadmap across Phases 0 through 8 with explicit acceptance criteria.
14. Final status declarations: ARCHITECTURE CONDITIONAL, IMPLEMENTATION NOT AUTHORIZED, PRODUCTION MIGRATIONS NOT AUTHORIZED, PRODUCTION SECRETS NOT AUTHORIZED, PRODUCTION DEPLOYMENT NOT AUTHORIZED.
